statement: Intel Foundry reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8 billion, up 31% year over year, with the CEO citing advanced packaging and wafer foundry capacity.
why: A growing second-source foundry and advanced-packaging line is the main alternative to the dominant incumbent, and its revenue growth is the readable proxy for that capacity being taken up.

impact.mechanism: Growth in an alternative foundry and packaging supplier adds capacity outside the constrained incumbent line, easing the packaging bottleneck over time.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor results release with segment revenue stated directly; note the release's capex line item is flagged in the document as needing confirmation and is not relied on here.
